description: Probabilistically safe vehicle control in a hostile environment (de-probabilised MDP, after Cizelj-Ding-Lahijanian-Pinto-Belta, IFAC 2011). The vehicle (coalition) must reach the pick-up region and then the drop-off region while staying alive, against moving adversaries and static obstacles that give every crossing a residual, unavoidable probability of loss. Can the vehicle SURELY complete the mission? Expected UNKNOWN -- a soundness witness: in the paper the maximal mission probability is < 1 (0.141 and 0.805 for the two scenarios), so no strategy guarantees delivery against a worst-case (demonic) resolution of the residual loss. This is the qualitative reading of the paper's Pmax[ alive U (pickup & alive U dropoff) ] objective.
